text:
alex: Quick heads-up — target v1.12.0 cutoff in ~10h. Posting a compact checklist; please ack and flag blockers.

alex: Checklist:
- version bump (package.json, docker tags)
- changelog entry + links
- QA smoke signoff (staging)
- security review (deps + config)
- docs updated (API + migration notes)
- cherry-picks for hotfixes
- cut branch: release/v1.12.0

sara: Ack. I have the docs edits, pushing PR now (PR #3125).

matt: On reviews — I can prioritize the UI-login fix (PR #3119). Autoscale tests (PR #3120) might slip a bit.

jen: QA: running smoke now, will report back in ~30m. Also verifying canary.

qa-bot: Smoke tests started on staging — https://ci/runs/9876 (logs streaming).

alex: Version bump decision: semver minor -> v1.12.0 (we added features + a small migration). I'll handle package.json + docker tags after merges.

sara: Changelog: added bullet for "smart routing" and bugfixes. Need a one-liner from eng-runtime for the routing change.

matt: Routing blurb: "Smart routing prefers hot-tier GPUs for short-sequence requests to reduce tail latency."

sara: Added that to the changelog and docs PR. PR #3125 ready for review.

jen: Smoke shows one flaky test: long-tail-keystore. Re-running.

jen: Re-run passed. QA signoff: staging smoke ✅

alex: @sec-team any outstanding approvals? We need green on dependency audit and config review.

sec-team: Quick check done — dependency audit flagged grpc-interop (low severity). Recommend pin to 1.4.2. We'll give final approval once pin PR is merged.

sara: I'll open the pin PR now.

sara: PR #3126 created to pin grpc-interop -> 1.4.2 in package-lock.

release-bot: Release branch created: release/v1.12.0 at commit abc123. Canary job queued.

release-bot: Canary passed in us-west-2 — https://ci/runs/9878. No regressions reported in baseline checks.

matt: Merged UI login (PR #3119). If someone runs the changelog generator after merges, please include those merges.

sara: Merged docs PR #3125. Changelog generation hint: `./scripts/gen-changelog --from=release/v1.11.0 --to=HEAD` then commit to changelog.md

alex: I'll bump package.json and tag once PRs are merged and sec PR is in. Cutoff is ~6h from now.

jen: Docs + changelog present in the branch, QA signoff confirmed.

sec-team: Pin PR looks good; merging now. Will follow-up with a short note in the compliance tracker.

release-bot: Tagging v1.12.0-rc.1 and creating release candidate. Artifacts: https://artifacts/release/v1.12.0

alex: All gates green from my side. Cutting the release branch in ~10m unless anyone objects.

matt: No blockers. :thumbsup: 

sara: No blockers here.

jen: No blockers — good to go. :shipit: 

alex: Cutting release/v1.12.0 now. Thanks for the quick turn-around, team!
